title: 第007章 挑事第008章 废
content_zh:
第007章挑事
陈默静静站在庭院中，望着痛哭流涕的李素芳，心中生起一丝莫名的悲凉。
树欲静而风不止，子欲养而亲不待，始终是人生遗憾。
姥姥走后，李家唯一疼爱老妈李素芳的亲人也没有了。那种失去唯一至亲的痛苦，前世陈默体会过，知道那种伤痛是何等的撕心裂肺！
在水晶棺前足足痛哭了半个小时，李素芳才被陈默大舅妈和二舅妈拉了起来，缓缓走出灵堂，眼睛又红又肿。
陈默大舅李立文叹息一声，道：“明天母亲出殡，今晚你先在这里休息，等明天母亲出殡后，你再回去吧！”
李素芳伤心过度，对周围一切充耳不闻，只是走到陈默身旁，抱住陈默，泪水又是忍不住的涌出。
“老妈，节哀！”陈默拍了拍李素芳后背，柔声劝慰。
李立文看向旁边那群李家年轻一代子弟，喊道：“李越，带你姑姑下去找个房间休息。”
“是。”
一个头上绑着白色孝布的少年，越众而出，走到陈默身前，古怪的看了眼陈默，躬身说道：“姑姑，请跟我来！”
李越，陈默大舅李立文的二儿子，陈默表兄，为人阴险刻薄，工于心计，在李家年青一代，地位不凡。
看着李越，陈默眼中突然露出一抹微不可查的笑意，根据前世的记忆，他知道，好戏，即将开演。
陈默扶着李素芳一路跟随李越来到一栋别墅前，李越淡淡说道：“姑姑，你今晚就在这休息吧，我去安排表弟。”
李素芳愣了下，说道：“让小默跟我住一起吧，不用在麻烦了。”
李越面色平静的解释：“姑姑有所不知，父亲交代过，同辈人住一个地方，小辈有小辈们住的地方，礼，不可乱！”
李素芳有些担忧的看向陈默，她知道李家人对陈默的敌视，有她在，李家人或许收敛些，可一旦陈默和她分开，那就危险了。
陈默明白老妈的担心，也知道这的确是李家的规矩，自己老妈根本没能力改变。
为了不让李素芳担心，于是，陈默一脸自信的说道：“老妈，就一个晚上，你放心吧，我不会有事的！”
一旁李越悄悄撇了眼陈默，不动声色的微微低头，嘴角露出一抹阴狠的笑容。

李素芳无奈的看着陈默，嘱咐道：“你自己小心，千万不可生出事端，如果有事，马上来这里找我！”
陈默心中无奈，他倒是不想惹事，可要是别人找他麻烦，他根本没办法阻止啊！
不过，陈默还是很听话的点头道：“老妈你就放心吧，一个晚上而已，能出什么事？”
李素芳想了想，就一个晚上，应该不会出事，点点头，看着陈默跟着李越离开。
李越带着陈默一直向前走，路过一排排空着的别墅，最后，来到一间偏僻的小房子前。
这里，距离李素芳住的那栋别墅，已经足够远了。
望着那间孤零零的小房子，陈默知道，那是李家人用来堆放杂物的仓库。
前世，他就是在这里，被李家小辈们关在房间中，狠狠揍了一顿，差点被打死。
陈默有些感慨，本以为重生，有些事情会发生改变，但历史依旧惊人的相似，最终，他还是无可避免的来到这里。
李越一脸阴笑看着陈默，露出毫不掩饰的鄙夷，没有李素芳在，他终于不用在掩饰。
“你晚上就住这吧！”
陈默平淡的看着他，道：“难道你们李家穷的连房子都没有了？居然让客人住仓库？”
李越一脸厌恶说道：“房子是给人住的，你这样的杂种，让你住仓库已经是抬举你了。”
前世陈默因为这两个字，躲在仓库哭了好久，但这一次，陈默不再有任何感觉。
content_en:
Chapter 007 Provoking trouble
Chen Mo stood quietly in the courtyard, looking at Li Sufang who was crying bitterly, and felt an inexplicable sadness in his heart.
The tree wants to be quiet but the wind doesn't stop, the child wants to be raised but the family doesn't wait for it, it is always a regret in life.
After grandma left, the only relative in the Li family who loved his mother, Li Sufang, was gone. Chen Mo had experienced the pain of losing his only close relative in his previous life, and knew how heartbreaking the pain was!
After crying bitterly in front of the crystal coffin for half an hour, Li Sufang was pulled up by Chen Mo's eldest aunt and second aunt, and slowly walked out of the mourning hall, her eyes red and swollen.
Chen Mo's uncle Li Liwen sighed and said, "My mother's funeral will be held tomorrow. You can rest here tonight. After my mother's funeral is held tomorrow, you can go back!"
Li Sufang was so sad that she turned a deaf ear to everything around her. She just walked to Chen Mo and hugged Chen Mo, tears pouring out uncontrollably.
"Mom, my condolences!" Chen Mo patted Li Sufang on the back and comforted her softly.
Li Liwen looked at the group of younger generations of the Li family next to him and shouted: "Li Yue, take your aunt down to find a room to rest."
"Yes."
A young man with a white mourning cloth tied on his head stepped out from the crowd and walked up to Chen Mo. He looked at Chen Mo strangely, bowed and said, "Auntie, please follow me!"
Li Yue, the second son of Chen Mo's uncle Li Liwen and Chen Mo's cousin, is a sinister, mean and scheming person. He has an extraordinary status among the younger generation of the Li family.
Looking at Li Yue, a subtle smile suddenly appeared in Chen Mo's eyes. Based on the memory of his previous life, he knew that a good show was about to begin.
Chen Mo supported Li Sufang and followed Li Yue to a villa. Li Yue said lightly: "Aunt, you can rest here tonight. I will make arrangements for my cousin."
Li Sufang was stunned for a moment and said: "Let Xiaomo live with me, no need to worry."
Li Yue explained calmly: "My aunt doesn't know something. My father has told me that people of the same generation live in the same place, and juniors live in the same place as their juniors. Don't mess with the etiquette!"
Li Sufang looked at Chen Mo with some worry. She knew that the Li family was hostile to Chen Mo. With her around, the Li family might be more restrained, but once Chen Mo separated from her, it would be dangerous.
Chen Mo understood his mother's worries, and also knew that these were indeed the rules of the Li family, and his mother had no ability to change them.
In order not to worry Li Sufang, Chen Mo said confidently: "Mom, it's just for one night. Don't worry, I'll be fine!"
On the side, Li Yue quietly glanced at Chen Mo, lowered his head calmly, and revealed a sinister smile at the corner of his mouth.
Li Sufang looked at Chen Mo helplessly and said, "Be careful and don't cause any trouble. If anything happens, come here and find me right away!"
Chen Mo felt helpless. He didn't want to cause trouble, but if someone else made trouble for him, there was nothing he could do to stop it!
However, Chen Mo still nodded obediently and said, "Mom, don't worry, it's just one night, what could happen?"
Li Sufang thought for a while, it would be just one night and nothing would happen. She nodded and watched Chen Mo leave with Li Yue.
Li Yue led Chen Mo forward, passing by rows of empty villas, and finally came to a small, remote house.
Here, it is far enough away from the villa where Li Sufang lives.
Looking at the lonely little house, Chen Mo knew that it was a warehouse used by the Li family to store sundries.
In his previous life, it was here that he was locked in a room by the younger members of the Li family and beaten so severely that he was almost beaten to death.
Chen Mo felt a little emotional. He thought that after rebirth, some things would change, but history was still surprisingly similar. In the end, he inevitably came here.
Li Yue looked at Chen Mo with a sinister smile, showing undisguised contempt. Without Li Sufang around, he finally didn't have to hide it.
"You can stay here tonight!"
Chen Mo looked at him calmly and said, "Are you, the Li family, so poor that you don't even have a house?"Got it? Actually letting guests stay in the warehouse? "
Li Yue said with a look of disgust: "Houses are for people to live in. For a bastard like you, letting you live in a warehouse is already a compliment to you. "
In his previous life, Chen Mo hid in the warehouse and cried for a long time because of these two words, but this time, Chen Mo no longer felt anything.
